load_K_Rt_from_P: load camera intrinsic matrix K and pose from a COLMAP projection matrix file
getNerfppNorm: compute NeRF++ normalization translate and radius from a list of camera objects
fetchPly: fetch a PLY point cloud file and return a BasicPointCloud with optional subsampling stride
storePly: store xyz coordinates, rgb colors, and normals to a PLY file on disk
load_image_or_feat: load an image from jpg/png or a normalized feature array from an npy file
